MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 37
   D. 1

2. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 4

3. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 12x
   D. 12x + 2

4. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 49
   C. 1
   D. 2

5. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 64
   C. 16
   D. 65

6. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 41
   C. 31
   D. 49

7. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 49
   C. 14
   D. 2

8. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 144
   C. 156
   D. 48

9. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 3
   C. 40
   D. 41

10. What is √100? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 11
   C. 50
   D. 100

11. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 105
   C. 44
   D. 30

12. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 43

13. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 36
   C. 77
   D. 22

14. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 25
   C. 10
   D. 26

15. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 40
   D. 400

16. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 22
   C. 122
   D. 121

17. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 18 cm³
   B. 12 cm³
   C. 27 cm³
   D. 9 cm³

18. Solve for x: x + 9 = 15. (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 9
   C. 7
   D. 15

19. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 28
   C. 11
   D. 3

20. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19.6
   C. 19
   D. 19.7

21. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.6
   B. 23.7
   C. 23
   D. 29

22. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 31

23. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. They are equal
   C. 1/4
   D. Cannot tell

24. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 18
   C. 81
   D. 36

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
